body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy adjacent after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Detect moving creatures within 2 units on your surface. Move up to 1 unit. On success, deal 2 Slashing Damage to one detected enemy.

surges.html: Ignore ordinary concealment for the attack.
After a hit, move 2 units along a wall or floor.

rider.title: Adaptation - Chimera
rider.html: Assume Composite Hunt (upkeep 1): ignore ordinary concealment within 2 units and cross a 1-unit gap during normal Movement. This occupies your single Adaptation slot.
